name: Minamisanriku (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Minamisanriku town emblem in green, blue and orange: a green stylised character with a blue stroke and orange disc above blue waves.
history: Municipal flag of Minamisanriku, a town in Miyagi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 3 April 2006.

features.role: Minamisanriku town emblem — a green stylised character with a blue stroke and orange disc above blue waves
